newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close higher on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close higher on fund buying.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi bourse rebounded to close higher on Monday as buying by foreign and domestic financial institutions more than offset early losses spurred by profit-taking, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 2.30 points higher at 676.07.
"Foreign and domestic institutional buying to check the falling prices boosted the market sentiment," said Ranjit Monga of brokers Gorahari Investments.
Another broker, Ramesh Arora of brokerage firm Diksha investments, said speculative buyers kept up the trend, enthused by trends in Bombay.
ACC closed 27.15 rupees higher at 1,217.0 rupees, on hectic institutional buying, brokers said.
State Bank of India gained 3.85 rupees to 228.80.
The Delhi Stock Exchange will remain closed from December 25 to December 29 for Christmas, bourse officials said.
